newsitem.title: USA: TENNIS-PAES UPSETS RADULESCU IN HALL OF FAME QUARTER-FINALS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-PAES UPSETS RADULESCU IN HALL OF FAME QUARTER-FINALS.

text.p: Leander Paes of India upset top seed Alex Radulescu of Germany
6-3 7-6 on Thursday to reach the semifinals of the $255,000
The 24-year-old Paes, surprise bronze medal winner at the
Atlanta Olympics, ended the quarter-final match in straight
sets by storming to a 7-1 decision in the tie-break.
Radulescu, ranked 83rd in the world, had reached the third
round at Wimbledon and the final of April's Gold Flake Open in
India, his first career final as a professional.
